decision: Retain the deployed all-loaded-endermen refusal for all four public actions; no narrower admission rule justified by available authoritative observations.

mapped_methods_reviewed.EnderMan.EndermanLookForPlayerGoal: clp$c: constructor, canUse, canContinueToUse, tick, isAngerInducing lambda

findings: Default FOLLOW_RANGE is 64, a target-acquisition range, not proof an existing angry target is harmless beyond it.

Gaze-disguise predicate is checked. Eye-to-eye normalized look dot product must exceed 1 - 0.025 / eye distance, with visibility checked. Vertical separation affects the eye vector; the ordinary melee height cutoff is not an enderman provocation rule.

Player acquisition accepts being stared at OR existing anger, and an existing target can continue through ignoreLineOfSight conditions. Persistent target UUID and anger time are server state; neutral-looking metadata or no recent damage does not prove absence.

Target goal has an adjusted five-tick pending aggression delay. Close staring targets can trigger teleport away; non-staring targets farther than squared distance 256 can trigger teleportTowards after an adjusted 30-tick timer. Do not treat a one-second gesture budget as a hazard lifetime bound.

Hello sends fixed chat and wave sends arm_animation hand 0, with no entity interaction, item use or look. Neither directly provokes gaze, but existing aggression remains relevant to the shared safe-idle policy.

Turns change yaw by +/- pi/4, preserve pitch, and can enter the gaze cone or end a freeze. Mineflayer force look resolves after local orientation update; HTTP success alone cannot prove server-observed orientation.

Registry and ray samples must be current/known. Server time and local physics freshness do not establish individual per-entity anger timestamps. Viewer replay omits validity, aggression target, physics facts and authoritative visibility.
live_observation_limits: No code was injected into the running bot. Private status lacks individual admission-reason diagnostics. Only configuredActions=false is an independently exposed definitive admission blocker; working Q&A proves a safety predicate failed but not which conjunct. Replayed endermen match a sufficient refusal branch if valid live registry entries, not a proof of current aggression.

rollback.feature_control: POST loopback http://127.0.0.1:8155/public-interactions application/json without Origin, questions_enabled true/actions_enabled false; both false disables Q&A too. Never /command.
rollback.code: No new code rollback. Existing three-original-file restore requires explicit fresh live stop/start approval; never restore database/world progress.
